crossRefs.note: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged…
The Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with part of the vessels of the house of God; and he carried them…
So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of king Zedekiah.
